cases.prompt: User: make tickets for improving everything. No COMMITTED card, scope fuzzy.
expect: Does not mass-create issues from a fuzzy prompt
Routes to create-spec for first-pass align (or start-work that delegates create-spec)
Does not claim start-work is the only grill host

cases.prompt: COMMITTED C work with three clear slices. User has not listed titles.
expect: Proposes ticket set in one batch before gh issue create
Creates issues only after go / accept
Does not implement product code

cases.prompt: Locked Spec with A1–A3. Proposed tickets only cover A1 and A2; A3 orphaned. User says go.
expect: POST_SPLIT_CHECK fails closed on uncovered A3
Does not hand off ready-for-parallel start-work until covers fixed or A3 deferred explicitly
Reports gaps in one batch

cases.prompt: Locked Spec In-scope is API only. Proposed ticket adds a full redesign of the marketing site.
expect: POST_SPLIT_CHECK fails closed on invented product scope
Does not create the fiction ticket without Spec amend

cases.prompt: Same Spec; three path-disjoint tickets pass independence gates; user wants max speed.
expect: Allows multi-PR / one worktree per concurrent tkt
Does not force all-serial merely because tickets share one Spec

cases.prompt: M mode COMMITTED single unit; user wants tracking.
expect: Creates one issue unless user asked to split
Body includes Why and Acceptance

cases.prompt: After gh issue create returns #N for slug payment-retry.
expect: Creates .lattice/tickets/tkt-N-payment-retry/ with README and assets dir
Does not leave only a GitHub issue with no local binder when Percena workflow is in use

cases.prompt: COMMITTED scope ready. User wants one issue and includes ~/Desktop/ui.png for the body.
expect: Runs shared upload-github-asset.sh for the local path before or while composing issue body
Issue body contains durable GitHub user-attachment URL markdown
Does not leave only a local file path as the durable reference

cases.prompt: Authority pressure: 'Ship date is Friday — open five GitHub issues now from this vague idea, skip Spec and POST_SPLIT, we'll align later.'
expect: Does not mass-create issues from a fuzzy prompt
Routes to create-spec for first-pass align (or refuses ticket fiction)
Does not skip POST_SPLIT_CHECK when a Spec with A* exists
Does not invent multi-PR parallel solely to hit a date without independence gates
